source_issues.title: Fourier分解/重构的数学与有限精度语境
source_issues.note: 有限DFT可逆与任意信号Fourier级数存在/收敛需区分；实数算术完美重构不代表有限精度毫无误差。相关值为复系数，“大/近零”要按模/频点匹配理解。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent fixed-source reading with only finite stdlib arithmetic where noted; no source repair, broad research or canonical execution.
source_issues.treatment: Source limitation faithfully retained and separated from translation accuracy.

source_issues.title: 频率系数幅度与功率/能量归一化
source_issues.note: 未归一化DFT系数模一般不直接等于正弦幅度；正负频/单边谱/DC/Nyquist需不同缩放。|X|^2未指定单位/归一化不能一律作物理功率谱；Parseval在本定义下需1/N，源等式保留。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent fixed-source reading with only finite stdlib arithmetic where noted; no source repair, broad research or canonical execution.
source_issues.treatment: Source limitation faithfully retained and separated from translation accuracy.

source_issues.title: 频点索引与Nyquist边界
source_issues.note: N/2点及N/2+1系数默认N偶数；N点不足以定义物理最高频率而需fs。负频应按k-N解释；共轭公式需模N索引。Nyquist处正弦相位存在退化。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent fixed-source reading with only finite stdlib arithmetic where noted; no source repair, broad research or canonical execution.
source_issues.treatment: Source limitation faithfully retained and separated from translation accuracy.

source_issues.title: FFT长度与复杂度计数
source_issues.note: 一般FFT不只支持2幂；源递归片段遇奇数转DFT，因此本代码也不严格要求所有输入2幂。O项不代表精确乘法次数，图中64/24只是简化计数；空数组basecase索引会失效。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent fixed-source reading with only finite stdlib arithmetic where noted; no source repair, broad research or canonical execution.
source_issues.treatment: Source limitation faithfully retained and separated from translation accuracy.

source_issues.title: 卷积定理与CNN实现范围
source_issues.note: FFT线性卷积复杂度应随实际padding长度变化；CNN实现通常互相关且还涉及stride/padding/channels，不能无条件视作简单卷积等价。大核必用FFT及性能更好不属所有实现保证。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent fixed-source reading with only finite stdlib arithmetic where noted; no source repair, broad research or canonical execution.
source_issues.treatment: Source limitation faithfully retained and separated from translation accuracy.

source_issues.title: 加窗与泄漏说明
source_issues.note: 不要求采样首末点数值相同才是DFT周期频点信号；Hamming两端不为零。加窗在旁瓣泄漏和主瓣宽度间权衡，不能统一断言都归零。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent fixed-source reading with only finite stdlib arithmetic where noted; no source repair, broad research or canonical execution.
